package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// GetTargetMastery returns one ordered projection per requested exact target.
// Missing rows are represented as UNKNOWN without creating database state.
type GetTargetMastery struct {
	Mastery repository.TargetMasteryReader
}

func (useCase GetTargetMastery) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	if useCase.Mastery == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("target mastery repository is required")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalizedTargets, err := domain.NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(targets)
	if err != nil || len(normalizedTargets) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	stored, err := useCase.Mastery.ListStudentTargetMastery(ctx, studentID, normalizedTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byTarget := make(map[string]domain.StudentTargetMastery, len(stored))
	for _, projection := range stored {
		byTarget[masteryTargetIdentity(projection.Target)] = projection
	}
	result := make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, 0, len(normalizedTargets))
	for _, target := range normalizedTargets {
		projection, exists := byTarget[masteryTargetIdentity(target)]
		if !exists {
			projection = domain.StudentTargetMastery{
				StudentID:     studentID,
				Target:        target,
				State:         domain.TargetMasteryUnknown,
				PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
			}
		}
		result = append(result, projection)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func masteryTargetIdentity(target domain.LearningTargetRef) string {
	return string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
}
